findings.title: Paginator option is passed to the pagination helper
findings.body: `enable_advanced_features` is passed to `self.paginate`, rather than directly to `OptimizedCursorPaginator`. The pagination helper does not accept or forward this paginator-specific option, so requests that meet this branch fail with a `TypeError` instead of returning audit logs. Forward it as a paginator constructor option or configure the paginator directly.

findings.title: Optimized paginator cannot build cursors for datetime fields
findings.body: The audit-log endpoint orders by `datetime`, but this implementation applies `math.floor` or `math.ceil` to the field value. Those functions do not accept `datetime` objects, so any non-empty response using the optimized paginator raises `TypeError` while building its cursor. Use the datetime key conversion implemented by `DateTimePaginator`.

findings.title: Negative offsets cause invalid queryset slicing
findings.body: Django querysets reject slices with a negative start index; they do not interpret them as reverse pagination. `Cursor.from_string` accepts negative offsets, so an optimized request containing one reaches this slice and raises `ValueError` instead of returning a response. Reject or normalize negative offsets rather than passing them to queryset slicing.
